args.body: When BUILDER hands off the committed corrected copy, independently compare its criterion names and weights in both languages against the pinned LOT-0000 fields. Record one focused pass or revise result tied to the corrected hash and reuse the existing acceptance verdict for unaffected checks. For a real eligible case, require evidence of current official source inclusion through the authorized private cycle before relying on that source. Keep case execution, recipient delivery, administrative acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement distinct. No test correspondence, customer data or public edits.

description: Independent review of the CAD 49 welfare brief identified a specific correction to the published lot weights. Assign the correction using the pinned official notice and require a source check before using it in an eligible case. Feedback is available with five unclassified sources, so eligible demand remains unknown. The November 20 checkpoint can proceed from permitted aggregate evidence. Live delivery requires an eligible case and verified case-local source inclusion. Order acceptance is administrative, and settlement requires founder confirmation. Treasury reports no verified funding or revenue. Keep the December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement and the independent public release gate.
